en: Colorized vintage view along a path beside a stone city wall leading towards a fortified complex with round towers and red roofs. Trees line the slope on one side and the wall on the other, while a woman and two children walk in the foreground. The sky is softly tinted blue and yellow. At the top of the card, printed text in German reads "Bautzen." on the left and "Blick vom Mühltor." on the right.
